items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: So I’m in a picture with the Obamas with the band. So that was a big highlight.

ctx.x: For the Obamas. So I’m in a picture with the Obamas with the band. So that was a big highlight. And you know, there are a lot of highlights. I mean Steely Dan, I love working with them. I love, you know, the first time, we’ve done Rochester Jazz Festival with my band several times. And the first time that people waited on-line to come to a gig of mine, that was like a highlight, I thought people are here, we don’t play for two hours. Really? So that was kind of, just the realization that people were actually…
They would pair you with a band and you were supposed to know a certain repertoire?
